notes: v234 — PIP-HOME-SHOWS-FACE-NOT-MAP (owner, Fri Oct 23, 2026 11:39 MDT, his screen recording): Back from the map correctly lands on the dashboard, but pressing HOME while navigation is running floated the SAME tracker strip face (timer + loads + instruction line) — not the map: 'in the sis it just shows the same sis when I press home while on dashboard.. Not the map as it should.' Standing law: when navigation is active, the floating picture-in-picture must BE the live map; the map shuts off only via End drive or the map's X. ROOT CAUSE: MainActivity.onUserLeaveHint called showPipFace() unconditionally (navDriving || sessionActive || armed) — mid-navigation the shell-drawn tracker face (the web layer even feeds it the next-direction line) covered the whole window, while the drive screen underneath had already swapped to its .nv-pip map posture on the shell's pipChanged event, hidden. FIX (MainActivity only): showPipFace() returns at once while ShiftTrackPlugin.navDriving — the guard sits in the face's only door, so every caller inherits the law, and the v231 see-through (app view INVISIBLE + transparent window background) is gated with it, so the app view is never hidden from the map. Everything else untouched: PiP still enters in both worlds (pipRatio still keys 16:10 wide while navigating, 4:3 for the tracker face), the pipWillEnter announcement still drives the web face swaps, the PiP system actions (toggle / load+ / load- / stop) still ride the float, and the home-screen widget still stands down in both worlds (one-float rule — a live tracker widget next to the map float would be the same double face he reported). The tracker bubble cluster remains the float whenever navigation is NOT active, exactly as v231 shipped it. NAMED RESIDUAL (noted, not built): if a drive were ended while the app is already sitting in PiP, the tracker face does not retro-appear over the ended drive screen until the next leave — End drive is an in-app full-screen action, so in practice the float restores on expand, as before.
